| **2010s** | *Kawhi Leonard* (drafted 2011, traded 2019), *Paul George* (drafted 2010, traded 2017), *Chris Paul* (trade 2019), *DeAndre Jordan* (long‑time core), *Jamal Crawford* |
| **Recent years (2020s)** | *Russell Westbrook* (trade 2020), *Anthony Davis* (trade 2020), *Lauri Markkanen* (trade 2021), *Jalen Green* (draft 2021), *Coby White* (draft 2021), *Jabari Parker* (draft 2021), *Kirk Hinrich* (coach, former player) |
